editorial_thesis: The useful frontier is shifting from model capability to operational interfaces: constrained decisions, attributable runs, verifiable media, and implementation skills that make agent systems deployable.

topic_groups.title: Constrained Agent Delivery
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Fresh Oct 12–13 signals make agent behavior more measurable and bounded: finite decisions, local execution, attribution, and tool controls.

sources.title: OpenAI DevDay 2026 recap
sources.why_selected: New Decisions API, computer use, Codex cloud, and security workflows in one developer release cycle.
sources.usefulness: Translate one Buildn workflow into explicit decisions, tools, evidence, and review gates.

sources.title: OpenAI Decisions API
sources.why_selected: Finite questions and permitted answers turn model output into a constrained control path.
sources.usefulness: Use for routing, approval classification, and safe next-action selection.

sources.title: GitHub local sandboxing for Copilot
sources.why_selected: Local isolation is now generally available for coding-agent execution.
sources.usefulness: Compare local and hosted execution boundaries for client repos.

sources.title: GitHub client telemetry attribution
sources.why_selected: Attribution and configurable capture make usage evidence more operationally useful.
sources.usefulness: Add actor, run, tool, and consent fields to agent telemetry.

sources.title: GitHub Copilot JetBrains controls
sources.why_selected: Model and MCP-server controls move provider/tool choice closer to the operator.
sources.usefulness: Expose model and tool policy instead of hiding them in defaults.

topic_groups.title: Content Provenance + Trust
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Google’s Oct 7 expansion makes provenance checking accessible, while C2PA and OpenAI’s EU work point to a practical trust layer for generated artifacts.

sources.title: Google SynthID Detector
sources.why_selected: Global English access lets anyone inspect supported AI-generated image, video, and audio provenance.
sources.usefulness: Add provenance checks to client media handoff and research dossiers.

sources.title: SynthID Detector
sources.why_selected: The direct verification surface is now available outside a specialist media workflow.
sources.usefulness: Test a small intake flow: upload, inspect, record result, flag uncertainty.

sources.title: C2PA official Content Credentials icon
sources.why_selected: A recognizable disclosure mark makes provenance legible to non-technical audiences.
sources.usefulness: Use the icon plus a machine-readable manifest in client deliverables.

sources.title: C2PA FAQ
sources.why_selected: The standard explains signed provenance without claiming that provenance proves truth.
sources.usefulness: Write the caveat into Buildn report templates: origin is not factual correctness.

sources.title: OpenAI EU text provenance
sources.why_selected: Text watermarking extends provenance beyond audiovisual media and into authored outputs.
sources.usefulness: Track provenance modality, jurisdiction, and verification status in artifacts.

topic_groups.title: Implementation Capability + Operator Skill
topic_groups.selection_rationale: The archive has covered many agent products; today’s gap is the human operating layer: shared agent surfaces, open embeddings, and the skills required to turn pilots into systems.

sources.title: OpenAI Apps SDK
sources.why_selected: Apps turn ChatGPT into a distribution and interaction surface for native workflows.
sources.usefulness: Evaluate whether a client workflow needs a task surface rather than a chat endpoint.

sources.title: Google I/O 2026 agent platform overview
sources.why_selected: The platform stack connects agent-first development, managed agents, AI Studio, and information agents.
sources.usefulness: Compare portability, deployment, and surface ownership before choosing a stack.

sources.title: EmbeddingGemma 2
sources.why_selected: A lightweight multimodal embedding model is a practical building block for local retrieval.
sources.usefulness: Prototype local semantic search where data residency matters.

sources.title: Claude Frontier Academy
sources.why_selected: A $100M program targeting 10,000 deployed engineers signals that implementation talent is the bottleneck.
sources.usefulness: Turn Buildn delivery into a repeatable operator curriculum, not bespoke prompting.

sources.title: Anthropic partner hub
sources.why_selected: A services track and certification ecosystem formalize the market around implementation partners.
sources.usefulness: Package a small, evidence-backed agent deployment offer for clients.
